question.problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 2x-8y=10 \\  & 3x-7y=5.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 10 \\ 3 & -7 & 5\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 10 \\ 3 & -7 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 5 \\ 3 & -7 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & 5 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
